title: Determine whether someone has signed in and whether everyone has signed in
goal: Use some and every to express that at least one and all of them are satisfied.
summary: The sign-in table saves the Boolean status of each person. The class board requires both judgments.
tasks: completes attendance(states) and returns { any, all }. any means at least one true, and all means everything is true.
In the empty list, any is false and all is true, indicating that there is no counterexample.

example.note: some can stop as soon as it gets true. every can be stopped as soon as it is false.

hint: calls two array methods respectively and puts the results into named properties.
